newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-METZ'S PIRES TO JOIN NEWCASTLE, PAPER SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-METZ'S PIRES TO JOIN NEWCASTLE, PAPER SAYS.

text.p: France international Robert Pires will join premier league Newcastle from Metz next week for 5.5 million pounds ($9 million), British newspaper the Sun reported in its Saturday edition.

It said Newcastle manager Kenny Dalglish agreed a deal with the French first division side in Paris on Wednesday -- the day 20-year-old Pires scored the equaliser in France's 2-1 victory over the Netherlands.
Pires, an attacking midfielder, played for Metz against Newcastle in the UEFA Cup earlier this season. ($ = 0.614 British Pounds)
